name: UiPath to Power Automate Desktop Enterprise Migration Rules & Diagnostic Engine
description: Comprehensive rule repository for detecting missing components, edge cases, enterprise dependencies, and providing actionable guidance & fallbacks for RPA engineers.

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: UiPath Orchestrator asset or credential call detected. In Power Automate Desktop, credentials must be retrieved from CyberArk, Azure Key Vault, or Power Platform Credentials.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Configure CyberArk or Azure Key Vault connector in PAD, or use Credentials.GetCredential action.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action:
# [ACTION REQUIRED] Replace with CyberArk / Azure Key Vault or PAD Credential
SET AssetValue TO $''''''

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: UiPath Orchestrator Queue activity detected. PAD uses Power Automate Desktop Work Queues in Dataverse.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Map to native PAD actions: WorkQueues.ProcessWorkQueueItem or WorkQueues.UpdateWorkQueueItem.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action:
# [ACTION REQUIRED] Map to Power Automate Desktop Work Queues (Dataverse)
SET QueueItem TO $''''''

diagnostic_rules.missing_part: SAP GUI Scripting Authorization & Connection Profile
diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: SAP GUI automation activity detected. Requires SAP GUI Scripting enabled on both the SAP Server and client workstation.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Verify 'saplogon.ini' connection profile and use PAD's native SAP.OpenConnection and SAP.ExecuteTransaction actions.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: # [ACTION REQUIRED] Verify SAP GUI Scripting is enabled. Use SAP.OpenConnection in PAD.

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: IBM 3270 / 5250 / VT100 Terminal activity detected. In PAD, terminal automation requires the Terminal Emulation module.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Use TerminalEmulation.Connect with your host address and port (default 23 or 992 for SSL).
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: TerminalEmulation.Connect Host: $'''localhost''' Port: 23 TerminalType: TerminalEmulation.TerminalType.VT100 ConnectionTimeout: 30 Session=> TerminalSession

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: Excel VBA Macro execution detected. Excel Trust Center must allow macro execution.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Use Excel.RunMacro action in PAD. Pass workbook instance and exact macro sub/function name.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: Excel.RunMacro Instance: ExcelInstance Macro: $'''Module1.MyMacro'''

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: Database SQL operations detected. Requires configuring an ODBC / OLEDB connection in PAD.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Use Database.ConnectWithConnectionString and Database.ExecuteSqlStatement in PAD.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action:
Database.ConnectWithConnectionString.Connect ConnectionString: $'''Provider=SQLOLEDB;Data Source=localhost;Initial Catalog=DB;Integrated Security=SSPI;''' Connection=> DatabaseConnection
Database.ExecuteSqlStatement.ExecuteSql Connection: DatabaseConnection Statement: $'''SELECT * FROM MyTable''' QueryResult=> dtQueryResult

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: Email operation detected. Ensure local Microsoft Outlook or Exchange Web Services is authorized.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Use Outlook.Launch and Outlook.RetrieveEmailMessages or Outlook.SendEmailThroughOutlook in PAD.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action:
Outlook.Launch Instance=> OutlookInstance
Outlook.RetrieveEmailMessages.RetrieveEmails MailFolder: $'''Inbox''' Account: $'''''' EmailsToRetrieve: Outlook.RetrieveMessagesMode.Unread Messages=> RetrievedEmails Instance: OutlookInstance

diagnostic_rules.missing_part: Desktop / Web UI Control Repository Binding
diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: UI Automation activity converted to reliable keyboard/shortcut actions. For complex UI trees, bind to PAD UI Elements.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: If targeting specific deeply-nested fields, capture the control using the PAD UI Element picker.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: # [INFO] UI action mapped to active window. Bind to PAD UI Element if specific targeting is needed.

diagnostic_rules.missing_part: Power Automate Desktop Browser Extension (Edge / Chrome)
diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: Web browser automation detected. Requires Microsoft Power Automate extension installed in Edge or Chrome.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Use WebAutomation.LaunchEdge or WebAutomation.LaunchChrome in PAD.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: WebAutomation.LaunchEdge.LaunchEdge Url: $'''https://www.google.com''' WindowState: WebAutomation.BrowserWindowState.Normal ClearCache: False ClearCookies: False WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60 BrowserInstance=> Browser

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: PDF OCR / Document Understanding detected. In PAD, OCR requires Windows OCR or Tesseract engine.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Use OCR.ExtractTextWithOCR.ExtractTextFromFileWithWindowsOcr or native Pdf.ExtractTextFromPDF actions in PAD.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: Pdf.ExtractTextFromPDF.ExtractText PDFFile: $'''C:\Doc.pdf''' DetectLayout: False Password: $'''''' ExtractedText=> ExtractedText

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: File compression or extraction detected. In PAD, compression is handled natively by the Compression module.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Use Compression.ZipFiles and Compression.UnzipFiles in PAD.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: Compression.ZipFiles.Zip Files: FilesToZip ArchiveFile: $'''C:\Archive.zip''' CompressionLevel: Compression.CompressionLevel.Normal

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: FTP/SFTP transfer detected. Requires FTP server host address, port, and authentication credentials.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Use FTP.OpenConnection, FTP.DownloadFile, or FTP.UploadFile in PAD.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: FTP.OpenConnection.OpenConnection Server: $'''ftp.example.com''' Port: 21 UserName: $'''user''' Password: $'''pass''' Connection=> FtpConnection

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: Clipboard operation detected. In PAD, clipboard access is provided by Clipboard.GetText and Clipboard.SetText.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Ensure no other background processes overwrite clipboard contents during execution.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: Clipboard.GetText Text=> ClipboardText

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: Word document processing detected. Requires local Microsoft Word desktop client.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Use Word.LaunchWord, Word.SaveWord, and Word.CloseWord in PAD.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: Word.LaunchWord.Launch Visible: False DocumentPath: $'''C:\Doc.docx''' Instance=> WordInstance

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: Advanced DataTable manipulation detected (Merge, Join, Lookup).
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Use Variables.MergeDataTables, Variables.FilterDataTable, or LOOP FOREACH in PAD.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: # [INFO] Use Variables.MergeDataTables or Variables.FilterDataTable in PAD.

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: TryCatch / Exception block detected. In PAD, exception handling is configured using BLOCK ... ON BLOCK ERROR or action-level ON ERROR.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Wrap sensitive steps inside BLOCK ... ON BLOCK ERROR ... END.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action:
BLOCK ErrorHandlingBlock
    # Enclosed actions
ON BLOCK ERROR
    SET ErrorFlag TO True
END

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: Surface/Image-based automation detected (often used for Citrix / Remote Desktop). Image matching depends heavily on screen resolution and DPI.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Ensure test workstation and production runner use identical display resolution and 100% DPI scaling.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: # [WARNING] Image matching detected. Verify 100% display scaling on runner machine.

diagnostic_rules.missing_part: VB.NET LINQ Query to Native PAD Filter Transformation
diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: VB.NET LINQ query detected in expression. PAD Robin does not support LINQ lambda syntax.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Replace LINQ query with Variables.FilterDataTable or a LOOP FOREACH block.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: # [ACTION REQUIRED] LINQ expression detected. Use Variables.FilterDataTable or LOOP FOREACH to filter.

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: InvokeWorkflowFile detected. In PAD, child workflows are executed as Subflows sharing flow-wide global variables.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Ensure the called workflow is created as a Subflow tab in PAD under the same name.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: # [INFO] Subflow invocation. In PAD, click 'Subflows' -> create corresponding subflow tab.

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: SecureString / Password field detected. In PAD, passwords should be stored as Direct Encrypted Text or retrieved from credentials.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Mark variable as sensitive in PAD variables pane or use Credentials manager.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: # [SECURITY WARNING] SecureString detected. Set variable as 'Sensitive' in PAD variable settings.

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: Custom code execution detected. Converted to native Scripting.RunPowershellScript.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Verify execution policy and required .NET libraries are accessible in the PAD runtime environment.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: # [INFO] Custom script mapped to PowerShell execution.

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: REST/HTTP Web Service request detected. Transpiled to Web.InvokeWebService.InvokeWebService.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Verify URL endpoint, Authorization headers, and content-type in the PAD action settings.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: Web.InvokeWebService.InvokeWebService Url: $'''https://api.example.com''' Method: Web.Method.Get Accept: $'''application/json''' ContentType: $'''application/json''' ConnectionTimeout: 30 FollowRedirection: True ClearCookies: False FailOnErrorStatus: False EncodeRequestBody: True UserAgent: $'''Mozilla/5.0''' Encoding: Web.Encoding.AutoDetect AcceptUntrustedCertificates: False ResponseHeaders=> ResponseHeaders Response=> responseString StatusCode=> responseStatus

diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_message: C# null-coalescing or ternary conditional syntax detected.
diagnostic_rules.recommended_action: Ensure conditions are converted into IF ... THEN ... ELSE statements in PAD.
diagnostic_rules.pad_fallback_action: # [INFO] C# conditional syntax detected. Converted to IF-ELSE block.

unmapped_fallback_policy.diagnostic_template: Activity '{activity_name}' ({activity_tag}) is not mapped to an exact PAD action. An informative visual placeholder card and variable initializers have been generated so the flow remains 100% pasteable.
unmapped_fallback_policy.recommended_action: Inspect the source activity parameters in UiPath and replace the placeholder with the closest Power Automate Desktop equivalent action from the Actions pane.
unmapped_fallback_policy.pad_comment_template:
# [TODO - MANUAL ACTION NEEDED] Unmapped UiPath Activity: {activity_name} [{activity_tag}]
# Check source parameters and replace with matching PAD action.
